saw_lines: Wine buyers choose a shop by trust, then come back for tastings and events they hear about from people they know.
So the sale is won on the first screen, where a new visitor decides fast if an event is worth the evening.
Your one live ad carries no proof number, so pick a count you can back, like reviews or orders shipped, and lead the next ad with it.
ads_1: Event creative with one review count and a first visit offer, tested against the film story
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram and Youtube
